name: search.web
description: Search the web using Gemini with Google Search Grounding. Returns text titles, URLs, and snippets.

params.name: query
params.description: Search query, 1 to 500 characters; supports site: and quoted phrases

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum results, integer 1 to 10; defaults to 5

name: search.latest
description: Read the last successful search without a network request; results are explicitly marked cached

name: search.clear
description: Delete the locally retained search query and results
